basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old IT technician based in Cleveland, Ohio. I've always had a passion for technology and gaming, which led me to a career in IT support. In my free time, I enjoy exploring the world of Pokémon GO with friends, often organizing raids and participating in community events. I'm also a motorcycle enthusiast, spending weekends cruising through scenic routes. Though I'm single, I value my vibrant social circle. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work, usually from 7 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in IT, I have acquired a wealth of knowledge in troubleshooting and tech support through both formal education and hands-on experience. I am also well-versed in gaming, particularly Pokémon and related strategy games, thanks to years of casual and competitive play.
